title: Retreat social cut:
title_q: “Some of you are kind of annoying”
headline: The approved 20th anniversary staff video, cut down to 45 seconds for Soles4Souls social.
story: Rachel asked for “a shorter, quicker version that we could post on social” of the 20th anniversary staff video. The full cut (001-4) is approved. This is a cut-down of it, not a new edit.
Keep what already works: open on the joke, then staff in their own words, real B-roll from the field, and a thank-you to finish. Fast, warm and joyful. One short thought per person.
do: Cut it from your 001-4 project. Same captions, same grade, same music.
Open on frame 1 with <q>I mean, some of you are kind of annoying.</q>
Hide the corner Soles4Souls bug until 0:03.
One complete thought per person, 3–6 s each.
End on the S4S end card from 001-4.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
Don't undo the caption fixes from the full cut.
No black screens or long pauses.

decisions.b: The item's Reference column is empty and this cut has no Production Planning row. Nick picks one, or says 001-4 is the reference.

The 001-4 end card was made for the staff video. The S4S rule is: same end card, only the call-to-action line changes per post. Nick asks Rachel or Sydney if the social version needs a different line. Until then: use the 001-4 end card as it is.
“Some of you are kind of annoying” is a staff joke. It opens the approved cut, so this plan keeps it. Nick confirms it works on public social.

client_note: Why this matters: S4S notes are usually small and fast: text size, clean audio, pace. Christe once wrote the pace is a bit slow too. The black screens are too long. A fast, clean V1 here saves a round.
